rv.q: Theatre L'Acadie's The Swan is funny and intriguing.
From its tumultuous beginning to its thrilling denouement, “The Swan” sucks you in and holds your attention throughout the two-hour runtime.

Fortunately, the fascinating dynamics between Dora, Bill, and Kevin keep this metaphorical tale as riveting and intoxicating to observe as any barroom brawl—until the moment of truth, when freedom is the only option.
"The Swan" is a poignant and engaging production that showcases the talents of its cast and crew.

cn.t: Critics praise "The Swan" for its thought-provoking storytelling and powerful performances, with strong marks for its exploration of complex themes and striking staging that creates a uniquely theatrical experience.
